name: Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman
benefit: **Awards:** • First Place: ₹5,100/- • Second Place: ₹4,100/- • Third Place: ₹3,100/-
_eligibility_text: Students securing First, Second, or Third position in Sanskrit subject in the following examinations will be eligible: - High School Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad) - Intermediate Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad) - Purva Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad) - Uttar Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad) - Shastri and Acharya Examinations (Uttarakhand Sanskrit University, Haridwar and Central Sanskrit University, Campus Devprayag, etc.) - Graduate and Postgraduate classes of higher education institutions (on the basis of marks obtained in Sanskrit subject).
